## Biography

Redonesses is an independent system firmly controlled by the lawless Clan of Redonesses. In September 3312, the damaged and adrift prison ship EVE-597 was discovered in the system by pilots, prompting the Independent Detention Foundation to ask onlookers to keep a safe distance pending a full investigation.
